steps.name: Sluggish Soldier
steps.text: Hey, did you hear? Supposedly that guest of honor we were keeping an eye on, the Doctor or whatever, was attacked by Silverash's people?

steps.name: Nosy Soldier
steps.text: You only just heard about it? The news is everywhere.

steps.name: Sluggish Soldier
steps.text: Then why don't you tell me what the hell is going on? Wasn't this Doctor person invited by Enciodes himself?

steps.name: Nosy Soldier
steps.text: Well, the version of the story I heard is, the attackers apparently thought that after the Doctor went over, Arctosz offered some under-the-table deals.

steps.name: Sluggish Soldier
steps.text: Huh? Master Arctosz wouldn't do something like that!

steps.name: Nosy Soldier
steps.text: Dumbass, can't you tell this is obviously nonsense made up by the attackers?

steps.name: Nosy Soldier
steps.text: If you ask me, after finding out that Arctosz is going to be hosting the Doctor, Enciodes is trying to set Arctosz up.

steps.name: Nosy Soldier
steps.text: Maybe the people behind the attack were sent by Enciodes too.

steps.name: Sluggish Soldier
steps.text: Yeah, that makes sense, just as you said.

steps.name: Sluggish Soldier
steps.text: Then why are we spending all this time keeping tabs on this Doctor? They're probably not in cahoots with Enciodes.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I didn't fully understand you before, so I ask your forgiveness if I have offended you in any way.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: As you are Enciodes's honored guest, I should be watching my words...

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: But, something doesn't add up about this attack made against you.

options: I can't determine what the purpose would be.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Enciodes...

options: No, he doesn't stand to gain anything from this.
(I have my own ideas about who's behind it, but...)

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I could've sworn they were trying to harm you to give Enciodes an excuse to seek retribution against the Paleroche clan, accusing them of failing to protect you.

options: A crime is a far graver offense than dereliction of duty.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: That's what I think too. They clearly already received the information that Weiss passed along on behalf of Enciodes, yet still are distrustful of you.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: It's almost as if...

options: And used the premise we just discussed to incite them.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Ugh...
Hah, well said.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais, we always said you were a skilled tactician and had a good head on your shoulders. But looks like you still have a lot to learn from the Doctor.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You're exactly right, Sir.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Oh, right, Valais. Pass this message on for me – My men don't need to keep watch over the Doctor anymore. Just focus on guarding our territory.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: As for the guards the Doctor brought along, they will be allowed to come and go freely from now on.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I just happened to overhear a bit of your conversation from the hallway.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't have any interest in your guessing games, but I might be able to offer you some clues.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Kjeragandr is our witness. Doctor, I apologize for the rudeness of the Paleroche clan––

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: On my name as head of the house of Paleroche, I swear to Kjeragandr that I was not the one who instigated this attack.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If you are willing to believe me, let me assure you that there are absolutely no scoundrels in the Paleroche clan that would carry out such a malicious attack behind my back.

options: Thank you for your trust, Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hm? I never said anything about trusting you, Doctor.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But at least I am certain now that you aren't up to any mischief.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hahaha! Good.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Doctor, I may not be much of a philosopher, but even a rough-around-the-edges man like me can smell that there's something unusual brewing in Kjerag.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That damned Enciodes, suddenly talking about ceding power back to the Saintess, then driving Gnosis away, and now putting you in this position...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And someone attacked you in the midst of it all.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Let me be honest – I can't help but to suspect that Enciodes is up to no good, even if he hasn't shown the slightest flaw in what he's doing.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But I'm not going to sit around and wait for the land granted to us by Kjeragandr to fall into danger...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What is it?

options: Us making amends could also mean...
If our enemy is able to predict your response...
Then they no longer need to use me as a smokescreen.
They've finished their preparations, and there's not much time left.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What?!
Boom–– A massive explosion goes off in the distance.
The people outside whisper amongst each other, debating whether or not it is going to snow.
The people inside lower their heads without a word, shouldering an intangible burden.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Gnosis Edelweiss.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Madame Ratatos Browntail.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It seems like I've finally earned the privilege of talking with you face-to-face?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You can't fool me with that feigned humility, Gnosis.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You are plenty smart yourself. Let there be no shady dealings between honest people.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you didn't want something from me, you would not have been trying to meet me again and again.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Heh. If you're just trying to assert your dominance here, then I do believe it is time for me to bid thee farewell.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't be in such a hurry, Gnosis. I have a few questions for you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: When I first heard that the Edelweiss clan followed Enciodes back to Kjerag, I frankly was not too surprised.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I thought you either had some evidence to prove that the Edelweisses would not be adverse to the Silverash clan, or perhaps, you had something to hold over Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But neither you nor Enciodes have said anything about what happened back then, while you still allow the Silverashes to rebuke you for your shamelessness.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What keeps you going? I'm curious.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...He promised me a future.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: A future?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Kjerag's future. An emerging industrial country that would allow me to utilize my talent in research without fear of plagiarism, misuse, or suppression.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Needless to say, I never expected you to understand in the first place, Ratatos. You will never be a researcher after all.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It may be difficult for you to understand how thrilling it is to freely explore the innovation and application of technology, backed by plenty of resources and privilege. To be given a legitimate purpose.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So that's the deal you struck. You give him your skills, and he provides you a stage.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Surely you aren't going to tell me that he pushed you out and made you take the fall just to protect himself.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Is this all that Karlan Trade's cost-benefit analysis amounts to?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You seem to have a lot of faith in Karlan Trade. Why didn't you accept the offer to work under Enciodes two years ago?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't be ridiculous. No matter how powerful Enciodes is, he cannot change the faith that has been deeply rooted in the bones of our people for thousands of years.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Karlan Trade can only grow as big as the Tri-Clan Council and the Vine-Bead Court allow, and it is impossible for Kjerag to industrialize––

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: —Wait.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So he's found a new bargaining chip?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: There was no way for Enciodes to turn the people of Kjerag against Kjeragandr, so he had to reach a compromise.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But he's been stuck there for far too long. No matter how many times I tried to push him, he seems indifferent.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Until there finally came an opportunity to turn things around.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ensia's Oripathy symptoms are under control, and though there still isn't a cure, she was able to return to him alive and well...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...and excitedly told him that it might be possible to deepen cooperation with an outside party to better control the spread and harm of Oripathy at a lower cost.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No, Enciodes wouldn't...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Of course not. Once the gate to Kjerag is opened, it cannot be completely sealed again.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The number of Infected living in Kjerag will only increase– this is the reality of our world. During the process of Kjerag's continued development, the ability to deal with Oripathy will ultimately become a new bargaining chip.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: He is about to make the people of Kjerag decide between faith and technology, and faith alone will no longer protect them from Oripathy.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Empty rhetoric. There's no proof.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Come with me then. Bring your people along, including those who can fight, and I will show you something.
